whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Dark Cafe & Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has an impressive 4.4★ rating across 1,300+ reviews in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/darkcafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Dark Cafe & Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with digital menu integration, table reservation, and mobile-first speed for your patrons in Old Jakkanpur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, pricing, aur actual photos setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
